items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Einkommensteuerbescheid 2025
items.quote: Mit dem Einspruch können Sie diesen Bescheid anfechten, und zwar binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: The notice is dated Mon 15.06.2026. As a tax letter sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO) = Fri 19.06.2026 (posting-day assumption: the printed document date is the posting day). The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts the day after delivery (§ 108 Abs. 1 AO, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 20.06.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number, 19.07.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 19.07.2026 is a Sunday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next working day, Monday 20.07.2026.
